title: Nuns offer food, medical care to protesters arrested in Muntinlupa

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Benedictine sisters visited Camp Bagong Diwa in Taguig City on Monday, Nov. 16, to provide food and medical care to individuals arrested in Muntinlupa City as they prepared to march toward Liwasang Bonifacio. According to the Southern Police District, more than 200 individuals who were supposed to join a larger protest against the Pax Silica initiative and US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines were arrested during an activity in Barangay Sucat on Sunday, Nov. 15, allegedly for holding the gathering without a permit.
